summary: Click a UI element and a shockwave ripple expands from the click point.
overview: Drop it on any UI Graphic. Clicking fires an expanding ripple from the click point, warping the sampled UVs and pulsing a highlight along the ring. One ripple at a time — clicking again mid-ripple restarts it at the new point rather than layering.
useCases: Material-style touch feedback on buttons and cards.
Making a large flat panel feel responsive to touch.
A hit or impact pulse on a UI element.

params.tuning: Subtle is the point. High values visibly tear the image rather than reading as a ripple.
Long durations mean a second click cancels the first mid-flight, which can read as unresponsive.

gotchas.title: One ripple at a time, by design
gotchas.body: Rapid clicking restarts rather than accumulating. That keeps the shader cheap and is a visual limitation to know about.
